summary.zh: 机位焦距不变，只拍动作
summary.en: Nothing moves but the scene

sentence.zh: 镜头固定不动，机位、焦距和构图都不变，只有画面里的人和物在动
sentence.en: the camera is locked off: position, focal length and framing stay unchanged while only the subject and scene move

summary.zh: 几乎不动，带一点呼吸感
summary.en: Still, with a faint breathing drift

sentence.zh: 镜头基本固定，只有极轻微的呼吸感漂移，构图保持稳定
sentence.en: the camera is almost still, with only a faint breathing drift and steady framing

summary.en: Move in toward the subject

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}向前推进，逐渐靠近主体
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pushes in toward the subject

summary.en: From a medium shot to a face close-up

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}推近，从中景收到人物面部特写，焦点始终在眼睛上
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pushes from a medium shot into a close-up of the face, focus held on the eyes

summary.zh: 推近画面里的关键细节
summary.en: Move in on the key detail

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}推向画面中的关键细节，周围环境逐渐出画
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pushes in on the key detail while the surroundings leave the frame

summary.zh: 突然快速推近，带冲击感
summary.en: A sudden fast push for impact

sentence.zh: 镜头突然快速推近主体，带来冲击感
sentence.en: the camera snaps in toward the subject for impact

summary.en: Move back to show the setting

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}向后拉远，主体变小，周围环境逐渐显露
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pulls back, the subject shrinks and the surroundings come into view

summary.en: From a close-up out to a reveal

sentence.zh: 镜头从主体特写{speed}后拉，揭示出意想不到的完整场景
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pulls back from a close-up of the subject to reveal an unexpected wider scene

summary.en: Back out to a wide establishing view

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}拉远到全景，交代人物与环境的关系
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pulls out to a wide shot that shows the subject in its setting

summary.en: Turn left from a fixed spot

sentence.zh: 镜头在原地{speed}向左摇，横扫过场景
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pans left from a fixed position, sweeping across the scene

summary.en: Turn right from a fixed spot

sentence.zh: 镜头在原地{speed}向右摇，横扫过场景
sentence.en: the camera {speed} pans right from a fixed position, sweeping across the scene

summary.en: Tilt from bottom to top

sentence.zh: 镜头在原地{speed}向上摇，从下往上展示主体
sentence.en: the camera {speed} tilts up, revealing the subject from bottom to top

summary.en: Tilt from top to bottom

sentence.zh: 镜头在原地{speed}向下摇，从上往下展示主体
sentence.en: the camera {speed} tilts down, revealing the subject from top to bottom

summary.en: A blurred whip to a new subject

sentence.zh: 镜头快速甩向一侧，带出运动模糊，随即停在新的主体上
sentence.en: the camera whips to one side with motion blur and lands on a new subject

summary.en: Slide left alongside the subject

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}向左横移，与主体保持平行，前景从画面中滑过
sentence.en: the camera {speed} trucks left parallel to the subject, foreground sliding through the frame

summary.en: Slide right alongside the subject

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}向右横移，与主体保持平行，前景从画面中滑过
sentence.en: the camera {speed} trucks right parallel to the subject, foreground sliding through the frame

summary.en: A sideways move with layered depth

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}横移，前景、中景和背景以不同速度移动，空间层次分明
sentence.en: the camera {speed} slides sideways so foreground, midground and background move at different speeds

summary.en: Follow the character from behind

sentence.zh: 镜头在人物身后{speed}跟随前进，始终保持相同距离
sentence.en: the camera {speed} follows the character from behind at a constant distance

summary.en: Back away ahead of the character

sentence.zh: 镜头在人物前方{speed}后退，人物朝镜头走来，距离保持不变
sentence.en: the camera {speed} backs away in front of the character, who walks toward it at a constant distance

summary.en: Track alongside the character

sentence.zh: 镜头在人物侧面{speed}平行跟随，人物始终在画面中部
sentence.en: the camera {speed} tracks alongside the character, keeping them centred

summary.en: Follow along their gaze, over the shoulder

sentence.zh: 镜头越过人物肩膀跟随其视线前进，前景保留一部分肩膀轮廓
sentence.en: the camera follows over the character's shoulder along their gaze, part of the shoulder kept in the foreground

summary.en: Rise to a high angle as the view opens

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}向上升起，从人物视线高度升到俯视，视野逐渐开阔
sentence.en: the camera {speed} cranes up from eye level to a high angle as the view opens up

summary.en: Descend from high above to eye level

sentence.zh: 镜头{speed}从高处下降，落到人物视线高度
sentence.en: the camera {speed} cranes down from high above to the character's eye level

summary.en: Rise while arcing toward the subject

sentence.zh: 镜头像摇臂一样{speed}划出弧线，同时升起并转向主体
sentence.en: the camera {speed} sweeps an arc like a jib, rising while turning toward the subject

summary.en: Half a circle to the left

sentence.zh: 镜头围绕主体{speed}向左环绕半圈，主体始终在画面中心
sentence.en: the camera {speed} orbits half a turn to the left around the subject, keeping it centred

summary.en: Half a circle to the right

sentence.zh: 镜头围绕主体{speed}向右环绕半圈，主体始终在画面中心
sentence.en: the camera {speed} orbits half a turn to the right around the subject, keeping it centred

summary.en: A full circle around the subject

sentence.zh: 镜头围绕主体{speed}环绕一整圈，背景随之旋转
sentence.en: the camera {speed} circles the subject a full turn while the background rotates behind it

summary.en: Documentary-style light shake

sentence.zh: 手持拍摄，镜头有自然的轻微晃动和呼吸感，像纪录片跟拍
sentence.en: handheld camera with natural slight shake and breathing, documentary style

summary.en: A jittery shake that builds tension

sentence.zh: 手持镜头晃动明显、节奏急促，制造紧张不安的感觉
sentence.en: a jittery, urgent handheld camera that builds tension

summary.en: Walks along, bobbing with each step

sentence.zh: 肩扛镜头跟着人物行走，步伐带来有节奏的起伏
sentence.en: a shoulder-rig camera walks with the character, bobbing in rhythm with the steps

summary.en: The lens zooms in, the camera stays

sentence.zh: 机位不动，焦距{speed}变长，画面逐渐放大到主体
sentence.en: from a fixed position the lens {speed} zooms in on the subject

summary.en: The lens zooms out, the camera stays

sentence.zh: 机位不动，焦距{speed}变短，画面逐渐展开
sentence.en: from a fixed position the lens {speed} zooms out to reveal more of the scene

summary.en: A sudden zoom for emphasis

sentence.zh: 镜头突然急速变焦推向主体，制造戏剧化的强调
sentence.en: a sudden crash zoom onto the subject for dramatic emphasis

summary.zh: 主体大小不变，背景拉伸
summary.en: The subject holds, the background stretches

sentence.zh: 镜头一边后退一边变焦推近，主体大小不变而背景透视剧烈拉伸
sentence.en: the camera dollies back while zooming in, so the subject keeps its size as the background perspective stretches

summary.en: Fly forward high over the scene

sentence.zh: 航拍视角从高空{speed}向前飞越场景，地面景物从下方掠过
sentence.en: an aerial view {speed} flies forward over the scene as the ground passes below

summary.en: Clear a ridge to reveal the vista

sentence.zh: 航拍镜头越过山脊或建筑等遮挡后，{speed}揭示出远处的全景
sentence.en: an aerial camera clears a ridge or building and {speed} reveals the vista beyond

summary.en: Look straight down and rise

sentence.zh: 镜头垂直俯视主体并{speed}上升，主体在画面中越来越小
sentence.en: looking straight down, the camera {speed} rises as the subject grows smaller

summary.en: A fast dive that skims the ground

sentence.zh: 第一人称穿越机视角高速俯冲、贴地穿行，转弯时镜头倾斜
sentence.en: an FPV drone shot that dives fast and skims the ground, banking into turns

summary.en: Roll the frame off balance

sentence.zh: 镜头沿光轴{speed}旋转，画面逐渐倾斜，带来失衡感
sentence.en: the camera {speed} rolls around its axis and the frame tilts into unease

summary.en: Shift focus from front to back

sentence.zh: 机位不动，焦点从前景{speed}转移到背景的主体上
sentence.en: from a fixed position the focus {speed} racks from the foreground to the subject behind

summary.en: A frozen moment, the camera sweeps around

sentence.zh: 时间几乎静止，镜头围绕凝固的瞬间快速环绕
sentence.en: time almost stops while the camera sweeps around the frozen moment

summary.en: See through the character's eyes

sentence.zh: 以人物的主观视角拍摄，镜头随其视线和步伐移动
sentence.en: shot from the character's point of view, moving with their gaze and steps
